name: Insurances Reports
query:
SELECT
    je.patient AS "PID:Link/Patient:120",
    je.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:170",
    je.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:120",
    je.sales_invoice AS "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:170",
    je.name AS "Journal Entry:Link/Journal Entry:170",
    jea.party AS "Insurance:Link/Customer:200",
    jea.debit AS "Debit:Currency:120"
FROM `tabJournal Entry` je
INNER JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
    ON jea.parent = je.name
INNER JOIN `tabCustomer` c
    ON c.name = jea.party
WHERE
    je.docstatus = 1
    AND je.posting_date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
    AND jea.party_type = 'Customer'
    AND c.customer_group = 'Insurance'
    AND jea.debit > 0
ORDER BY
    je.posting_date DESC,
    je.name DESC;
